# Fueled for the Future: Arvia Kicks Off Tenerife’s LNG Season


Nov 2, 2026


Share


Arvia is helping kick off a new season of LNG cruising in Tenerife.


The P&O Cruises ship became the first cruise ship of the 2026-2027 season to receive liquefied natural gas (LNG) at the Port of Santa Cruz de Tenerife during its recent call.


And it’s only the beginning. The port expects 33 LNG bunkering operations this season, up more than 80% from last year, with Carnival Corporation among the cruise companies using LNG during calls in Tenerife.


LNG is one of the fuels helping reduce air pollutants from a ship’s exhaust compared with conventional marine fuels. The growing availability of LNG infrastructure at ports like Tenerife supports Carnival Corporation’s ongoing efforts to pursue practical solutions that can support further reductions in greenhouse gas emissions, including the use of drop-in alternative fuels such as bio-LNG, as part of its decarbonization efforts.
